name: erikwang2013/aetherupload-webman
description: AetherUpload for webman and eight more hosts: chunked large-file upload with resumable transfer, instant upload (秒传) and integrity check. Framework-agnostic kernel with adapters for webman, native PHP, Laravel, ThinkPHP, Symfony, Slim, Hyperf, Yii2 and Yii3. Optional S3-compatible object storage driver (local by default).

suggest.predis/predis: 开启秒传（instant_completion）所需；未安装时秒传不可用，其余功能不受影响
suggest.ext-curl: S3 存储驱动（storage.driver=s3）所需；未安装时仅 S3 模式不可用，其余功能不受影响
suggest.webman/console: webman 下运行 aetherupload:groups / :build / :clean 三个控制台命令所需（webman 应用的 CLI 本身即由它提供）
suggest.yiisoft/yii-runner-http: Yii3 宿主所需（连同 yiisoft/router、yiisoft/router-fastroute、yiisoft/yii-console 等）。本包不 require 任何框架，这些由宿主应用自己带
